full_judgment: 16. Learned Advocate for the defendant-petitioners, Mr Md Asaduzzaman firstly submits that in the contract it was embodied that any, dispute/claim arising between the parties of the Contract and involving any breach of its terms would be decided by the Competent Courts of Geneva, Switzerland and that such a claim would be governed by the Swiss law. It was contented that in the aforesaid premises, no suit could be instituted against the defendant in the First Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka in Bangladesh, in violation of the above mentioned terms of the Contract. Secondly, it was further submitted that defendant-petitioner Idemia France SAS (formerly Oberthur Technologies Societe Anonyme) with whom the Contract was entered into by the plaintiffs was a company incorporated under the law of France, having registered office in France and was therefore, a non-resident foreign company. Thus a Court in Bangladesh, had no jurisdiction to try the suit against the defendant which was a foreign company. In support of this submission, learned Advocate cited the following decisions reported in 1966 AIR 155, 17 BLD (AD) 249 = 49 DLR (AD) 187, AIR 1980 SC 1239, AIR 1950.
